geometry.interval: within-condition 25th/75th percentiles over 712 optimizer steps, not confidence intervals
geometry.rho_opp: max(0,-dot_before)/(task_direction_norm**2+eps); before cap and group learning rates
geometry.left_axis: 100*rho_opp; log; all plotted 14M medians and IQR endpoints are positive; underlying aligned zeros retained in quantiles
geometry.right_axis: r/b; log scale; thin traces per kappa, bold unsmoothed median over five kappas
geometry.cap_rule: trust_scale < 1; includes first step with zero learning rate

optimizer.source_optimizer: GPT-NeoX v1 Apex/DeepSpeed FusedAdam in AdamW mode
